replies.body:
> Real responses may report only one

Is this true for Cohere?

I'm not sure, the PR description says Cohere sends both. I'm unsure whether it sends one or the other, or potentially both at the same time. If it's one or the other, a fallback wouldn't be necessary.
As far as I know, Cohere always sends both and so no need for a fallback.
